subject: planner: fix index merge union case couldn't sink limit into index merge reader (#48590)
summary: Reviewed planner-only changes against first parent. The functional change fixes index-merge cop-task cost underestimation in `getTaskPlanCost` by adding the costs of `idxMergePartPlans` when `indexPlanFinished=true` (previously only the table-side plan cost was counted). This can change plan selection and enables limit sinking into `PhysicalIndexMergeReader` in union cases (as covered by the added plan test). No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, concurrency, privilege/visibility, transaction/session behavior, or runtime/protocol handling within the touched planner logic.
